mentions.name: Mega Man Battle Network 2 decompilation
mentions.description: A reverse-engineering project that decompiles the author's childhood video games, starting with Mega Man Battle Network 2. Early initialization routines have been polished and verified, and parts of the game engine have been traced, revealing a large state-machine architecture. Planned next steps are reversing the saving system to build a save editor and the music system to enable listening to the game's music.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I started a new side project: decompilation of my cherished childhood video games. Many Mega Man games, starting with Mega Man Battle Network 2.
mentions.author: matheusmoreira
